android_build.result_location: GitHub Actions run for this commit; reported separately after execution

limits: Synthetic host SQLite/files and separate JVM processes; no real user data or services.
Directory fsync uses a host Linux adapter. Android lifecycle, SQLite locking and phone storage are not exercised.
No physical power-loss tests or arbitrary byte-corruption guarantee.
D14 remains partly open: whole-import/ZIP resource bounds and a separate pre-import database safety copy.
